title: Public Grievances Commission, Govt of NCT of Delhi: Cause List (Annexure-2)
publishes: A table of grievances before the Commission: diary no., file no., applicant name, year, respondent department, and a status that is either 'Disposed of' or the next hearing date. Each row links to a detail page with the hearing orders.
update_frequency: No schedule is published. It follows the hearing calendar (on 2026-10-19 the next hearing dates ran from 22.10.2026 to 19.11.2026). The site's page cache can serve a copy 1-2 days old.
limits: Only grievances that reached the Commission, not PWD Delhi's own complaints. Paginated: 20 rows per page, ?page=0, ?page=1, ... (3 pages, 42 cases, 14 departments on 2026-10-19, none of them the Public Works Department). Applicants are named; there is no complaint number a citizen would know. Site menus come before the table in the text, so match on table-row lines.
